summary: Scalar-deleting-destructor-style pattern (__userpurge). Always calls DestroyLocaleObjectFreeResourcesCallDtor(a2) to release the object's owned resources, then, when the low bit of the flag a3 is set, calls FreeWrapper_7bcf(a1) to free the object memory itself. Returns a1. No callers are recorded in the packet.

operations.description: Guard on the low bit of a3: if (a3 & 1) != 0 the object memory is freed.
Conditionally free the object memory: FreeWrapper_7bcf(a1).

unresolved: Meaning of a2 (passed via ebp) and what object/context it identifies for the resource-destruction call is unknown.
The exact behavior of FreeWrapper_7bcf (heap free wrapper vs. reference-count release) is not established.
The a3 low-bit check resembles the MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor free flag but that association is not independently confirmed.
